summary: An excellent Blitz: almost every big city anyone can name scores. As a classic daily it is a trap, because the UN 2025 method pushes Mumbai, Beijing, Sao Paulo, Mexico City and New York out of the top 10.
reasons: Casual classic run found Tokyo, Shanghai and Delhi, then lost all 5 lives on New York #22, Beijing #16, Mumbai #12, Mexico City #15 and Sao Paulo #13. The ranks teach something, but the player is out by guess 8.
Blitz is a joy: 85 cities carry a stat, and a casual 90 s run scored 32 of 34 (Jakarta at #1 is a fun surprise).
Top 10 matches the UN 2025 column, and the prompt names the source. Bombay, Calcutta, Saigon and New Delhi all match; 'rio' does not.
fixes: Add 'Rio' as an alias of Rio de Janeiro (#33); 'rio' is not recognized.
